test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following functions is NOT a part of District Administration?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Postal Services**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **District Administration **is the term used to describe the management of governmental duties inasmuch as they pertain to an area that is formally recognized as a district.
 
• The district collector, also known as the** district magistrate**, is in charge of a district's administration and is a member of the Indian Administrative Services (IAS).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Functions** of District Administrator:

 
 
• To keep the** district's law and order**.
 
• **Executing** relief operations in the event of emergencies like famine and floods.
 
• Keeping up with** land documents **and obtaining money.
 
• Supplying** public services** and keeping an eye on the development process as a whole.
 
• Monitoring how the** Panchayati Raj System** is being used.
